topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I know I put in a lot of work on that paper, and I stand by every word I wrote. It wasn’t easy, but I researched thoroughly, cited all my sources, and made sure my ideas were original. When I heard the accusation, I was taken aback, but I’m confident in what I turned in. I’ve decided to show my draft notes and research process to the committee as evidence of my efforts. I’ve also taken the initiative to schedule a meeting with my professor to walk through my paper and explain my thought process. I’m prepared to defend my work and, more importantly, my integrity. This is a chance to prove how committed I am to my academic responsibilities.
